out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO SOAP AT HAND SINK ACROSS FROM COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM PROVIDED SOAP.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED SINK AT FRONT CASHIER STATION WITH NO PAPER TOWELS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM PROVIDED PAPER TOWELS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED PAINT, CLEANING CHEMICAL BOTTLES STORED ON SHELF NEXT TO COVERED CONTAINERS OF RICE SOAKING IN WATER.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CFM MOVED ALL NON-FOOD ITEMS TO SEPARATE SHELF. STORE ALL CHEMICALS AND HOUSEKEEPING SUPPLIES IN SEPARATE AREA FROM FOOD.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BAGS OF VEGETABLES, CONTAINERS OF FOOD ON FLOOR IN KITCHEN AND WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM MOVED ALL FOODS TO SHELVES.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: OBSERVED MISSING/CRACKED GROUT THROUGHOUT FLOORING IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Wall, floor, and ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, warewashing areas, and toilet rooms. REGROUT TILES TO CREATE SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE SURFACE. HALAL KABOB (Inspection Date: 08/18/2026) Page 2 of 3
